statement: Lambda's public on-demand price for Nvidia B200 SXM6 capacity is $6.69 per GPU per hour in the eight-GPU configuration, as listed on its pricing page fetched October 4, 2026, with no prior rate or effective date shown.
why: This is a static listed rental level with no stated baseline or change on the page, so it is useful only as a current price marker for the newest widely rented accelerator.

impact.mechanism: Listed rental rates set the revenue a specialist cloud provider can earn per accelerator hour, which over time shapes how many accelerators it can justify buying; with no baseline here, the level carries no direction.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA B200 SXM6 -- 8x GPU: '$6.69' per GPU/hour

confidence.basis: Provider's own public price list, but no effective or last-updated date is shown on the page.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 3.99 -> 6.69 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda (lambda.ai pricing page)
